author: Kusha N M
raw:
ಅನುಸರಿಸು ಹರಿಯನ್ನು ಅರಿವುದಕೆ ತತ್ವಗಳ
ಅನುಭವಕೆ ತತ್ವತರೆ ತೋರುವರು ದಾರಿ
ಅನುಕರಿಸೆ ಅಧ್ಯಯನ ಅನುಭಾವ ವೇದ್ಯವದು
ಅನುನಯದ ನಡೆಯಿರಲಿ ಮೂಢಮನುಜ

lines: Follow Hari to know the principles;
those who know truth show the way to experience;
if you imitate them, study and inner experience become known;
let your conduct be gentle, O deluded one.
en.bhavartha: Follow the Divine, and learn from those who know the truth. Study and inner experience come to those who follow good examples. Be gentle in all you do.
en.note: Posted the same day as a kind word to Sri Hari; ‘Hari’ is both God and his name.
